```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(forecast)
library(DT)
library(zoo)
```


```{r}

DATA_FILE <- "Countries Over Time.csv"   # <-- put your historical file here

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Forecast: U.S. Trade Balance by Country"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("country", "Select a Country", choices = NULL),
      helpText("Trade Balance = Exports − Imports"),
      checkboxInput("show_test", "Show Train/Test (last 12 months)", TRUE)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      h4("Historical Trade Balance"),
      plotOutput("ts_plot", height = 260),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.show_test == true",
        h4("Train → Test Forecast"),
        plotOutput("tt_plot", height = 260),
        DTOutput("acc_table"),
        hr()
      ),
      h4("Forecast for 12 months ahead"),
      plotOutput("fc_plot", height = 260),
      DTOutput("fc_table")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session){

  # ---- 1) Read & check data ----
  df <- reactive({
    validate(need(file.exists(DATA_FILE),
                  paste0("Cannot find '", DATA_FILE, "'. Put it in the app directory.")))

    dat <- readr::read_csv(DATA_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

    needed <- c("Country","Month","Year",
                "Total Exports Value ($US)",
                "Customs Import Value (Gen) ($US)")
    missing <- setdiff(needed, names(dat))
    validate(need(length(missing) == 0,
                  paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing, collapse=", "))))

    dat %>%
      mutate(
        date = my(paste(Month, Year), quiet = TRUE),
        `Trade Balance ($US)` =
          as.numeric(`Total Exports Value ($US)`) -
          as.numeric(`Customs Import Value (Gen) ($US)`)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(`Trade Balance ($US)`)) %>%
      arrange(Country, date)
  })

  observe({
    updateSelectInput(session, "country",
                      choices = sort(unique(df()$Country)),
                      selected = head(sort(unique(df()$Country)), 1))
  })

  # ---- 2) Build TS safely ----
  ts_data <- reactive({
    req(input$country)
    d <- df() %>% filter(Country == input$country)
    validate(need(nrow(d) >= 6, "Not enough data for this country."))

    start <- c(year(min(d$date)), month(min(d$date)))
    y <- ts(d$`Trade Balance ($US)`, start = start, frequency = 12)
    # If all NA/constant, guard
    validate(need(sum(!is.na(y)) >= 6, "Series too sparse."))

    y
  })

  # ---- 3) Train/Test split (robust) ----
  tt <- reactive({
  y <- ts_data()
  n <- length(y)
  h <- min(12, max(3, floor(n/6)))

  start_time <- tsp(y)[1]
  freq <- frequency(y)
  end_train_time  <- start_time + (n - h - 1) / freq
  start_test_time <- start_time + (n - h)     / freq

  train_ts <- window(y, end   = end_train_time)
  test_ts  <- window(y, start = start_test_time)

  list(y = y, h = h, train = train_ts, test = test_ts)
})


  # ---- 4) Fit & Forecast with guards ----
  fit_tt <- reactive({
    tryCatch(
      auto.arima(tt()$train, seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  })
  fc_tt <- reactive({
    validate(need(!is.null(fit_tt()), "Model failed to fit on training data."))
    forecast(fit_tt(), h = length(tt()$test))
  })
  acc <- reactive({
    as.data.frame(accuracy(fc_tt(), tt()$test)) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Set") %>%
      select(Set, ME, RMSE, MAE, MAPE, ACF1)
  })

  fit_all <- reactive({
    tryCatch(
      auto.arima(tt()$y, seasonal = TRUE, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  })
  fc_final <- reactive({
    validate(need(!is.null(fit_all()), "Model failed to fit on full data."))
    forecast(fit_all(), h = 12)
  })

  fc_table <- reactive({
    tibble(
      Month = as.Date(as.yearmon(time(fc_final()$mean))),
      Forecast = as.numeric(fc_final()$mean),
      Lower95  = as.numeric(fc_final()$lower[,2]),
      Upper95  = as.numeric(fc_final()$upper[,2])
    )
  })

  # ---- 5) Outputs ----
  output$ts_plot <- renderPlot({
    autoplot(tt()$y) + labs(x="Year", y="USD") + theme_minimal()
  })

  output$acc_table <- renderDT({
    req(input$show_test)
    datatable(acc(), options = list(pageLength = 5, dom = 't'), rownames = FALSE) %>%
      formatRound(c("RMSE","MAE","MAPE"), 2)
  })

  output$fc_plot <- renderPlot({
    autoplot(fc_final()) + theme_minimal() + labs(x="Year", y="USD")
  })

  output$fc_table <- renderDT({
    datatable(fc_table(), options = list(pageLength = 12), rownames = FALSE) %>%
      formatRound(c("Forecast","Lower95","Upper95"), 2)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
